body:
Source: GitHub issue #658 (release-audit class false-green, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ e0768ff9: `packages/hollow-test/bin/hollow-test.mjs` around line 716 — when every diff-derived mutation target produces zero mutants overall, `results` stays empty and the run hits `if (results.length === 0) { console.warn(warnMsg); pass(); }` — a bare warning followed by exit 0. The SAME shortcut swallows a diff-derived file that cannot be read (line ~581: `console.warn('could not read ${target.file} — skipping'); continue;`) — if that unreadable file was the only target, `results` is empty for the identical reason and the run also exits 0 having tested nothing. Contrast with the tool's OWN correct pattern for an explicit `--target`/`--rails` file that produces zero mutants (around line 675-684): it calls `opError(...)` with a message ending 'refusing to report a pass' — exit 1, operational error, not a silent pass. The diff-derived middle case is the one remaining vacuous-pass path in this package after #70/#41/#35/#293 were closed everywhere else.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/hollow-test`: bin/hollow-test.mjs (the whole CLI — mutation generation, execution, verdict, in one file; no `lib/` split for the core logic), test/*.test.mjs. Tests: `npm test -w packages/hollow-test`. `opError` is already imported and used at the explicit-target fail-closed site — reuse it, do not invent a second error-reporting mechanism.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Track, alongside `results`, the SET of diff-derived target files that were actually attempted vs. selected for mutation (the same distinction the explicit-target check already makes via `mutableExplicitFiles` vs `mutantCountByFile`). When `results.length === 0` AND at least one diff-derived file was selected (i.e. this is not the separate, already-correct 'diff has zero eligible source files at all' case), call `opError(...)` instead of `pass()`. The message must name every selected file that produced no mutants OR could not be read, distinguishing the two reasons (mirror the explicit-target message's shape: state which files, why — 'no mutable line found' vs 'could not be read' — and end with 'refusing to report a pass').
2. The pre-existing 'diff has zero eligible source files at all' fail-closed path (if one exists separately from this `results.length===0` block — check for it) is UNCHANGED; do not touch it if it already fails closed correctly.
3. Do not change behaviour for the case where SOME diff-derived files produced mutants and others did not (that is issue #657, the `--max` budget-starvation case — explicitly out of scope here; only the ALL-ZERO / all-unreadable case is this ticket's concern).
4. `--json` output for the new failure path follows the SAME shape `opError` already produces for the explicit-target case (check its exact JSON contract in the surrounding code and match it, do not invent a new shape).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A diff adding a whole new exported function with no comparison/boolean/return-value/numeric-literal/ternary/guard/array-literal (nothing any mutation operator recognizes), with zero tests, on `--base <ref>`: exits 1 (not 0), stderr names the file and 'refusing to report a pass'. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/diff-zero-mutants.test.mjs`
- AC2 A diff-derived target file that cannot be read (deleted between diff computation and mutation, or a permissions issue) as the ONLY target: exits 1 with a message distinguishing 'could not be read' from 'no mutable line found'. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/diff-zero-mutants.test.mjs`
- AC3 Regression: the existing explicit `--target`/`--rails` zero-mutants fail-closed behaviour (opError, exact existing message) is unchanged — pin it with a test if the current suite does not already. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/diff-zero-mutants.test.mjs` and `npm test -w packages/hollow-test`
- AC4 Regression: a diff-derived file set with SOME real mutants that are all killed still exits 0 (the ordinary success path is untouched). verify: `npm test -w packages/hollow-test`
- AC5 Existing suite green (confirm actual baseline count; if any existing test pinned the old warn-then-pass behaviour for the all-zero diff case, rewrite it and say so in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/hollow-test`
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: issue #657 (--max budget-starvation, a partial-zero-quota case — different bug, same package, do not fold in).

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/diff-zero-mutants.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: the package suite, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to packages/hollow-test/bin/hollow-test.mjs, the new test, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(hollow-test): ...`, body must contain `Closes #658`.
title: hollow-test: diff-derived files that generate zero mutants (or are unreadable) fail closed, matching explicit-target behaviour
